unobjectionable.m: Free from objectionable elements; fit for all observers.

unobstructed.m: Free from impediment or obstruction or hindrance.

unobtainable.e: Timber is virtually unobtainable in the islands.

unobtrusive.e: A quiet, unobtrusive life of self-denial.

unobtrusively.e: Messengers were moving unobtrusively over the jet-black mountain ranges, bearing confidential tidings from sheikhdom to sheikhdom.

unobtrusiveness.m: The quality of not sticking out in an unwelcome way.

unobvious.e: In mathematical science connections are exhibited which...are extremely unobvious.

unoccupied.m: Not held or filled or in use.

unoffending.e: An unoffending motorist should not have been stopped.

unofficial.m: Not having official authority or sanction.

unopposed.m: Not having opposition or an opponent.

unorganised.e: Unorganised territories lack a formal government.
unorganised.m: Not having or belonging to a structured whole.

unoriginal.m: Not original; not being or productive of something fresh and unusual.

unoriginality.m: Uncreativeness due to a lack of originality.

unornamented.e: Functional architecture featuring stark unornamented concrete.

unorthodoxies.m: Any opinions or doctrines at variance with the official or orthodox position.

unorthodoxy.m: Any opinions or doctrines at variance with the official or orthodox position.
